name: clearUnit
summary: Strips the unit off a number, returning it unitless.

arguments.name: $value
accepts: a number, with a unit or without
a percentage, an angle and a time, which are numbers too
a string, a colour, a list, null, var() and a calculation Sass could not reduce are refused

caveats: Dividing two values of the same unit already gives a plain number, so `math.div(36px, 24px)` is `1.5` and this function adds nothing there. What Sass will not do on its own is compare a length against zero (`0px == 0` is false), convert between units it cannot relate such as rem and px, and round to a number of decimal places, since `math.round` keeps the unit and goes to the nearest whole one.
